2) Deduplicate the two “Alice Chan” contact entries:

3) Correct categorization for institutions:
   - Add the “Emergency” category to “Central Medical Center.”
   - For “Midwest Supply Co.,” remove the “Healthcare” category and add the standard “Work” category.
